profile.headline: Software Engineer focused on Software Infrastructure and DevOps solutions.
profile.summary:
Senior Backend Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable, distributed systems, cloud engineering and data pipelines.

I’ve spent the majority of my career designing and operating backend services that power large-scale systems for a large Cloud Provider—from high-throughput microservices to Spark-based ETL pipelines processing millions of records daily. At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, I owned core backend services and contributed across a broader set of microservices focused on cloud optimization and cost recommendations, with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and system design.

More recently, I’ve been building a mobile fitness startup as a founding engineer—designing a full-stack platform that generates personalized workout and nutrition plans using AI. This includes architecting asynchronous job processing systems, integrating adaptive feedback loops, and taking products from concept to production.

I enjoy working on problems that sit at the intersection of backend systems, data pipelines, and product—especially where performance, scalability, and real-world impact matter.

Tech: Java, Spring Boot, Apache Spark, Kafka, PostgreSQL, S3/MinIO, React Native, Cloud Platforms.

positions.description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 
Cloud Advisor
- worked on team since it’s greenfield inception up to production
-was SME on multiple microservices within the team
- lead an effort to bring API latency down to from 30 seconds to 1 second 
- lead efforts that reduced devops overload that ultimately reduced our sev2 pages to single digits
-was co-owner of a microservice that utilized Apache dataflow that took millions of datapoints and transformed it into a readable parquet for our microservices. This effort helped reduce our reliance on other teams API’s helping them with their latency cost
-Experienced with on-call duties and operationally strong
-was a terraform expert within team
